plan.notes: Official Cal Poly 2026-2028 Catalog (semester system; Cal Poly converted from quarters to semesters in Fall 2026), Child Development BS suggested four-year flowchart. The flowchart states it is a planning guide, not a required sequence. Term totals as printed: 14 / 15 / 14 / 14 / 16 / 14 / 18 / 15 = 120, matching the printed 'Total Units 120'. The 3rd-year Term 1 'Professional Skills Course' and 'Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Course (Upper-Division 4)' are printed as 3-4 units each, and the 3rd-year Term 2 'Upper-Division Science Course (Upper-Division 2/5)' as 3-4 units; each is modeled at 3 units to reconcile exactly with the printed term totals (16 and 14). GE 2026 pattern area codes in the plan (1A Written Communication, 1B Critical Thinking, 1C Oral Communication, 5A Physical Sciences, 5C Laboratory, Upper-Division 2/5, Upper-Division 3, Upper-Division 4). Prerequisites not listed on the flowchart; see official course descriptions in the 2026-2028 catalog.
